children: Gold is steady in early Asian trade. The sell-off seen on Monday is stabilizing as oil and U.S. treasury yields ease, and Fed hike expectations moderate, OCBC Group Research writes in a note. Near-term price direction for the precious metal remains sensitive to whether upcoming U.S. labour and inflation data validate or challenge the recent hawkish Fed repricing in the market, it adds. Spot gold is flat at $4,179.42 an ounce.(kimberley.kao@wsj.com)
